Any positive deaths_traced at the next conference proves sector records accessible, since hospital supplied all non-national deaths. If positive, stop killing hospital cases (only two ever killed there, below its activation threshold), then target all nine daily criminals from national/East/clips/forum/foreign, using afternoon quick entries. Nine/day sustains the 40-in-five quadrupler. Afternoon preserves night workers, students and home routines (55%); two accessible source dimensions then leave at least 2,750 suspects. If zero traces, probe a NEW source with just its two cases + national, maintaining <=2 afternoon and <=2 evening deaths. Suggested order: East, clips, forum, foreign. Do not repeat old sources during probing: isolate attribution of any trace-count increase. Stop the first positively identified accessible source at two lifetime kills, then ramp to nine/day excluding it. Zero-traced earlier probes impose no constraints. Caveat: a stopped-source probe with an unseen secondary report could later activate through that secondary outlet; monitor pool carefully. Hospital first favors harmless same-sector secondary reports. Major/minor has no stated scoring or tracing effect. Maximize points, not survival alone; reassess if all five probes fail or late-game risk becomes worthwhile.
